name: the environment is the caller's whole environment, GIT_DIR included
edits: return {**{k: os.environ[k] for k in PASSED_ENV if k in os.environ}, **ISOLATION, **extra}
expect: no inherited GIT_* variable reaches the environment
⭐ ...and the victim GIT_DIR pointed at is byte-identical

name: global git config is not turned off
expect: ⭐ a hostile HOME/.gitconfig and XDG config do not reach git

name: an extra that points git at the host is accepted
expect: an extra that would point git back at the host is refused (GIT_DIR)
an extra that would point git back at the host is refused (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT)

name: a GIT_CONFIG_* extra is accepted
expect: an extra that would point git back at the host is refused (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT)

name: the caller's extras are dropped
expect: an extra the caller passes is kept (an author identity)

name: the environment is read once at import, not per call
edits: {k: os.environ[k] for k in PASSED_ENV if k in os.environ}
{k: _SNAP[k] for k in PASSED_ENV if k in _SNAP}
expect: env() reads os.environ at CALL time, not once at import
